1.text: Every night, while the city slept, my father kept watch over a mall that was not his.
1.spoken: Every night, while the city slept, my father kept watch over a mall that was not his.

2.text: He sat by the doors in his old coat, through the long night shift.
2.spoken: He sat by the doors in his old coat, through the long night shift.

4.text: In the morning he came home tired, and still he made sure I went to school.
4.spoken: In the morning he came home tired, and still he made sure I went to school.

6.text: A school he could not afford, until he decided he could.
6.spoken: A school he could not afford, until he decided he could.

7.text: He never told me what it cost him.
7.spoken: He never told me what it cost him.

8.text: Today I work for a good company. I can help him now. But I am not where I want to be. Not yet.
8.spoken: Today I work for a good company. I can help him now. But I am not where I want to be. Not yet.

9.text: Because one day, I will rebuild his house.
9.spoken: Because one day, I will rebuild his house.
